messages.author: bba576a74eafc909
messages.subject: shinytheme "united" is not an available theme
parts:
Hello, 

In trying to run Wallace (in R 4.1.2), the following warning comes up and prevents the application from opening in my browser:

"Warning: Error in shinythemes::shinytheme: united is not an available theme.
Valid themes are: .
82:stop
81: shinythemes::shinytheme"

Any advice? I have checked for updates, re-installed packages, etc.

Thanks,
Amy

remotes::install_github("wallaceEcoMod/wallace")

Best,
Gonzalo
